initial_population: three development points of the prior map and 29 Latin-hypercube points of the seed
penalty_rule: an infeasible candidate or a simulation that does not pass the mechanical checks gets the penalty cost

validation_checks.candidate: population member with the lowest training cost

endpoint: checked generation with the lowest validation cost up to the stop; ties go to the earlier generation
selected_model: run with the lowest endpoint validation cost; ties go to the earlier generation and then to the lower seed
